Correction to the report above, from the job page step list and a second job_log call.

1. oi_probe was NOT skipped. The job page lists the steps in execution order: Set up job -> Run actions/checkout@v4 -> Run pip install -q pyarrow pandas -> Run python scripts/nai/oi_probe.py -> Run python scripts/nai/occ_oi_daily.py -> Post Run actions/checkout@v4 -> Complete job. So oi_probe ran before the failing step. The 'Skipped step' line in the body is wrong.
2. The failing step is confirmed: annotation on 'Run python scripts/nai/occ_oi_daily.py' reads 'Process completed with exit code 1'. Job 128121492870, 17s, branch main, sha e85547a.
3. The traceback is still not available to this lane. The bridge job_log response for this job truncates during the 'Fetching the repository' portion of the checkout step, well before the Python step, so no exception text was returned. The unguarded-DELO diagnosis in the body remains an unverified inference from source, not a quoted error.
4. Remaining annotations are boilerplate only: Node 20 deprecation on actions/checkout@v4, and the ubuntu-latest -> Ubuntu 26 migration notice. Neither is causal.

Net: run 42284432095 failed in scripts/nai/occ_oi_daily.py with exit code 1; the exact exception is unknown to the Venice lane. GPT owns the fix.
